reason: The README describes an agent toolkit for profiling, anomaly detection, summarization, and querying of CSV, TSV, and JSON datasets, making data processing the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供 CSV、TSV 和 JSON 数据集的概览分析、异常检测、摘要生成以及筛选分组聚合查询功能。
summaries.en: Provides agent-accessible profiling, anomaly detection, summarization, and filtering, grouping, and aggregation for CSV, TSV, and JSON datasets.

capabilities: Reads and parses CSV, TSV, and JSON datasets
Profiles columns, missing values, statistics, and distributions
Detects numeric outliers using IQR and z-score methods
Filters, groups, and aggregates dataset records
Produces structured data summaries and quality suggestions
